title: Accomplish — I'm proud of the progress I've made.

meaning.taglish: Matagumpay na matapos ang isang gawain.
meaning.fil: Matagumpay na matapos ang isang layunin.

examples.everyday: I accomplished my goal of cooking a new dish.

options: To abandon a goal before trying.
check.explanation: Accomplish: To successfully complete something. Example: I accomplished my learning goal.
check.hint: Notice the meaning in this example: I accomplished my learning goal.

explanation.en: Accomplish means completing something meaningful through effort.
explanation.taglish: Ang accomplish ay matagumpay na matapos ang isang gawain o layunin.
explanation.fil: Matagumpay na matapos ang isang layunin.

phrase.text: I'm proud of the progress I've made.

meaning.en: To express satisfaction with progress already achieved.
meaning.taglish: Gamitin ito kapag ipinagmamalaki mo ang sarili mong improvement.
meaning.fil: Pagpapahayag ng pagmamalaki sa sariling pag-unlad.

examples.work: I'm proud of the progress I've made this month.
examples.everyday: I'm proud of the progress I've made in English.

dialogue.speaker: Coworker
dialogue.text: How do you feel about your English practice?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: I'm proud of the progress I've made this month.

dialogue.speaker: Coworker

check.explanation: After 'have' (I've), use the past participle 'become', not the past-tense form 'became': I've become more confident.
check.hint: Read the example: I'm proud of the progress I've made this month.

grammarTip.explanation: 'I've' means 'I have'. Use have + past participle: 'I've learned' or 'I've become'. Say 'I've become more confident', not 'I've became'.

speaking.scenario: Reflect on your English journey: one achievement, one challenge, and your next goal.
hints: I'm proud of the progress I've made, and I'll keep practicing.
I'm proud of the progress I've made.
speaking.oneMinuteGoal: Describe the situation, your main point, and one example.
speaking.twoMinuteGoal: Add a reason, another example, and a clear conclusion.
speaking.modelResponse: I'm proud of the progress I've made. I've practiced asking for clarification and sharing updates. I still need time to find some words, and that's okay. My next goal is to give a short update in a meeting.

durationGuidance.en: One and two minutes are optional practice targets, not minimums. A shorter complete message counts. Start with two or three sentences, then add detail if useful.
durationGuidance.taglish: Optional targets lang ang isa o dalawang minuto. Puwedeng mas maikli basta malinaw ang mensahe. Magsimula sa dalawa o tatlong pangungusap.
durationGuidance.fil: Gabay lamang ang isa o dalawang minuto, hindi kailangang abutin. Sapat ang mas maikling sagot kung malinaw ang mensahe.
